text: Visitors have noted issues with the timed entry system, finding the check-in process cumbersome and the timing confusing, especially regarding when they can enter after their scheduled slot. Crowding in some of the early exhibit rooms has made the experience uncomfortable for some, leading a few to skip parts of the museum. There is also criticism about the use of AI in exhibits, with some feeling it conflicts with the spirit of Theodore Roosevelt. Food and beverage options received negative comments, particularly about quality and wait times. Accessibility information has been difficult to obtain, causing frustration for some visitors.

windows.7: Visitors continue to report issues with the food service, specifically slow preparation and poor quality of menu items like the grilled cheese sandwich. Several reviews mention confusion around the timed entry system, noting that guests can enter anytime after their scheduled time but only about 30 minutes before it, which affects planning and wait times. Crowding was reported mainly in the morning, with long lines at entry that clear up by midday. Positive comments focused on the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but wayfinding signage and parking received some criticism. Accessibility and the use of AI in exhibits were also noted but less frequently.
